pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth to slightly angular edge gradients; patches on the central flank exhibit larger spatial area compared to the smaller, more compressed patches near the ventral and neck transitions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected lattice of light-toned pathways forming distinct tri-point and tetra-point junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight narrowing at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, appearing as a continuous fringe of short, vertical pixel clusters.
